places.name: Vardas
places.highlights: Located on the 5th floor of Getu Commercial Building on Africa Avenue. Features international and traditional Ethiopian dishes (pizza, fish, beef, pasta), seasonal menus, hookah, beer, and liqueur. Known for interior design, live music, DJs, and outdoor seating.
places.safety_notes: Smoking allowed indoors. Be cautious of pressure to buy expensive liquor (up to ETB 19,200) and stay vigilant around security. High altitude may increase the effects of alcohol. Some reports of unprofessional staff.

places.name: Atmosphere
places.highlights: A cultural hub and pre-party spot known for late-night coffee, Iranian food (hummus), games, comedy shows, and events like Indian Cultural Day.
places.safety_notes: Welcoming atmosphere described as a hub for fun; recommended for any time of night. Use trusted drivers.

places.name: Bole
places.highlights: International business district near the airport; features modern infrastructure, expat-friendly amenities, international hotels, and chain restaurants.
places.safety_notes: Good night walking safety and excellent daytime safety. Decent lighting and security at night. English-speaking staff are common.

places.name: Kazanchis
places.highlights: Diplomatic and professional hub featuring high-end restaurants, high security presence, and international standards.
places.safety_notes: Excellent daytime safety and good night safety. Lowest harassment risk in the city; recommended for being out late.

places.name: Midtown Ultra Lounge
places.highlights: Popular, "dope" spot for nightlife and dancing.
places.safety_notes: Watch alcohol consumption due to high altitude effects.

places.name: Black Rose
places.highlights: Chill, upscale spot for cocktails and professional socializing.

places.name: Monarch Hotel 360 Lounge
places.highlights: Luxurious rooftop views featuring live DJs, cocktails, and a relaxed vibe.
places.safety_notes: Smart dress recommended. Avoid walking at night; use hotel taxis for transport.

places.name: Jazzamba Lounge
places.highlights: Historic hotspot inside the Taitu Hotel with a vintage ambiance; features up-and-coming Ethiopian jazz artists on weekends.
places.safety_notes: Located in a historic district; best to use a local guide for access and safe transport.

places.name: 2000 Habesha Cultural Club
places.highlights: High-energy venue featuring a mix of modern and traditional music, shoulder dancing, and audience participation.
places.safety_notes: High-energy environment; use trusted drivers or hotel taxis.

places.name: Luna Lounge
places.highlights: Modern music venue with energetic DJs and a vibrant late-night crowd.
places.safety_notes: Stick to well-known clubs, dress smart, and use trusted transport.

places.name: Illusion Lounge
places.highlights: Also known as Catch; trendy and stylish venue featuring cocktails, music, and occasional live bands.
places.safety_notes: Recommended place to end the night. Stick to well-known venues for safety.

places.name: Zoya
places.highlights: Monthly event described as the "Mecca of house music" in Addis; features house, EDM, and techno.
places.safety_notes: Described as having an incredible, positive vibe.

places.name: Wakanda
places.highlights: Popular nightclub noted for a high-energy "lit" atmosphere.
places.safety_notes: Part of the recommended local nightlife circuit.

places.name: Upscale
places.highlights: Known for being a "chill" spot; currently closed as part of the "corridor development" project.
places.safety_notes: Temporarily closed with no relocation yet.
